key_insight: The paper presents an LLM-assisted pipeline that automatically builds and incrementally updates a consistent knowledge graph of MLIP models from scientific documents.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, structured tracking of rapidly evolving materials-model ecosystems, supporting better model comparison, curation, and retrieval for materials discovery workflows.
method: Extract model facts from papers and articles using LLM-based information extraction.
Validate and correct the graph with SHACL constraints in a loop to catch inconsistencies.
Build the knowledge graph model-by-model so new models can be added iteratively with consistent representation.
evidence_signal: The approach is demonstrated on models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, with the abstract emphasizing that the resulting graph supports queries over the collected models.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on extraction quality and constraint coverage, so incomplete SHACL rules or noisy source text could still introduce errors.
paper_title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
